Robert Jones

Independent candidate for United States Senate, Tennessee · Challenger

Small business owner

Robert Jones is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Tennessee. He is from Jonesborough. He filed on March 4, 2026, qualified for the November 3, 2026 general election ballot by petition, and is registered with the FEC as Robert Thomas Jones.

Where Jones stands

Campaign finance
Says he will not accept campaign donations from individuals, parties, businesses or PACs, and asks supporters to give to local community organizations instead. Argues this gives every constituent an equal voice.
Government accountability
Proposes an "Accountability Act" that would create a secure online system for officials to survey constituents. Officials would have to explain votes that go against the survey results.
Immigration
Supports lawful immigration and stresses due process and the presumption of innocence until proven guilty.
Health care
Calls for rethinking America's health care system.
Housing
Supports making housing more affordable.
Education
Supports investing in education.
Environment
Supports expanding renewable energy and conservation.
Abortion
Opposes blanket abortion bans. Argues that medical situations differ and that doctors must be able to protect patients without fear of prosecution.
Guns
Supports the Second Amendment and says he personally enjoys shooting. Argues that reasonable regulations can fit with gun ownership and may help prevent tragedies.
Civil rights / religion
Supports equal rights for LGBTQ+ Americans and the separation of church and state and freedom of religion.
